user_story: As a user, I want to mark a task as complete so that I can track my progress.

positive.title: Successfully mark a task as complete
steps: User navigates to the task list
User selects a task marked as incomplete
User clicks on the 'Mark as Complete' button
System updates the task status to complete
positive.expected_result: The task is marked as complete and visually indicated as such in the task list

negative.title: Attempt to mark a completed task as complete again
steps: User navigates to the task list
User selects a task already marked as complete
User clicks on the 'Mark as Complete' button
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed stating that the task is already complete

edge.title: Mark a task as complete with network issues
steps: User navigates to the task list
User selects a task marked as incomplete
User clicks on the 'Mark as Complete' button while the network is down
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating network issues, and the task status remains unchanged
